`chicago-notes-bibliography-public.csl` is the public Chicago Notes & Bibliography
style downloaded from the Citation Style Language styles repository on 2026-10-10:
https://github.com/citation-style-language/styles/blob/master/chicago-notes-bibliography.csl

Its authors, version and Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike license are
preserved in the file's `<info>` element. This fixture was downloaded separately;
it is not a copy of the user's private CSL file.
